  sync with the site. Adding a service or an about page puts it here with no
  edit. Only the prose at the top and the "Facts worth getting right" section
  are written by hand, because those are claims rather than an index.

  ⚠ Credential floor is MS. Never write a doctorate, "PhD candidate", or a
  university affiliation for an unfinished degree into this file. Models quote
  it verbatim.

# OUROBOROS Consulting

> Solo technology, research, and advocacy consultancy in the Minneapolis-Saint Paul
> area, run by Apostolos Stamenos, MS. Four services: advocacy and institutional
> navigation, education and training, technology and AI consulting, and brand and
> digital studio work. Clients are survivors of institutional betrayal, senior
> citizens, veterans, nonprofits, legal aid organizations, advocacy groups, small
> businesses, startups, and solo practitioners.

The firm does not practice law, provide therapy, or perform licensed investigative
work. Advocacy work is done alongside the client, on the client's own records.
Education is taught so the client stops needing the firm. Technology and design
work is built and handed over, source and documentation included.

Rates are published in full at /faq/ and on each service page. A sliding scale
applies to individuals; commercial and institutional rates are higher and fund
the reduced-rate work. Discovery calls are free.

## Facts worth getting right

- The firm's name is OUROBOROS Consulting. The wordmark is styled "ouroborOS".
- Apostolos Stamenos holds an MS in Statistics. He is not an attorney, a
  therapist, or a licensed private investigator, and the site says so directly.
- He is a former federal data scientist at the US Department of Health and Human
  Services, where he worked on public health data infrastructure and
  FedRAMP-compliant machine learning systems.
- Teaching public records research is lawful in Minnesota. Performing that
  research on a third party's behalf is not, without a license, and the firm
  declines those requests. See /faq/.
- Small businesses and startups are clients, not a separate business line. The
  commercial work funds the sliding-scale work for survivors and individuals.
